scope: ADR-0089 / #150: run-manifest-gates captures each gate's output (was stdio:inherit), re-emits it verbatim, detects the vacuous marker (--allow-empty; whole-repo scope) a gate prints when it found nothing in scope, and renders a vacuous pass as '○ <id> vacuous' + an end note + a GitHub Actions warning/job-summary line; a vacuous pass still exits 0. no-ua-sniffing + owasp-lints add --ignore .githooks so a genesis-only consumer reads as vacuous. Aggregator is machinery so its sha256 was recomputed (parity/provenance/upstream-integrity re-verified); invoke change is not a sha change; no gate script edited. Review returned 1 LOW finding, RESOLVED in-diff: the marker coupling between the real gates and the aggregator was not guarded end-to-end (the AGG tests used a synthetic fixture line; the gate tests pinned only exit code) and the ADR overstated that it was. Fixed by adding test/vacuous-marker-contract.test.mjs (reads the aggregator's real VACUOUS_MARKER regex and asserts every --allow-empty gate produces it on an empty scope) + correcting ADR-0089's claim. No gate testSha256 changed (the contract test is a NEW file, not a gate's pinned test).
